day.name: National Naturopathy Day
day.about: India observes National Naturopathy Day on 18 November, set by the Ministry of AYUSH in 2018. The date honours Mahatma Gandhi, who became life chairman of the All India Nature Cure Foundation Trust on 18 November 1945. Naturopathy promotes healthy living through good food, exercise, fresh air and rest.

morning.task: On a map of South-East Asia, mark the 10 ASEAN countries and their capitals, and circle Manila, where this year's summits were held.

headlines.title: PM Modi attends the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit in Manila.
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi took part in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit in Manila, hosted by the Philippines as ASEAN chair for 2026. Leaders reviewed the ASEAN-India Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, including the Plan of Action for 2026-2030. At the East Asia Summit, Modi repeated India's vision of a peaceful, stable and prosperous Indo-Pacific and stressed dialogue and diplomacy. In Manila he also laid the foundation stone for redeveloping the Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara, the oldest gurdwara in the Philippines, set up in 1901.
headlines.gk: 2026 is the ASEAN-India Year of Maritime Cooperation, and 2027 will mark 35 years of ASEAN-India dialogue relations. The East Asia Summit brings together the 10 ASEAN members and 8 dialogue partners, including India.

headlines.title: Quad leaders announce new plans on maritime surveillance, trusted AI and cybersecurity.
headlines.summary: Leaders of India, the US, Australia and Japan — PM Narendra Modi, President Donald Trump, PM Anthony Albanese and PM Sanae Takaichi — reaffirmed their support for a free, open and stable Indo-Pacific. They opposed any attempt to change the status quo by force or pressure. Their joint statement announced an Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration, an AI Accelerator for trusted AI, and the first Quad Business Leaders' Forum in early 2027. The four countries will also hold their first maritime exercise using P-8 and P-3C patrol aircraft in 2027.
headlines.gk: The Quad (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) has four members: India, the USA, Japan and Australia. The P-8I is the Indian Navy's long-range maritime patrol aircraft.

headlines.title: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham says Brexit has not delivered and seeks closer ties with the EU.
headlines.summary: Speaking at the Lord Mayor's Banquet in London, UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Brexit had not worked and that Britain must reset its relationship with the European Union. He estimated that Brexit has cost the UK economy 4 to 8 percent of its GDP, and said trade with EU countries has dropped sharply. A UK-EU summit is due in Brussels on Friday, where deals on trade in food and drink, energy and emissions are expected. Burnham is Britain's seventh prime minister since the 2016 referendum.
headlines.gk: In the 2016 Brexit referendum, 52% voted to leave the EU and 48% to remain; the UK formally left on 31 January 2020. The EU now has 27 member countries and its main institutions are in Brussels.

headlines.title: Cyclone Akvan strengthens in the Bay of Bengal and is set to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast on Friday.
headlines.summary: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said Cyclonic Storm Akvan was moving north-northwest over the Bay of Bengal. It was expected to become a Severe Cyclonic Storm and then a Very Severe Cyclonic Storm by Thursday morning. It is likely to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coast between Nellore and Tuni on Friday, 20 November. Fishermen have been told not to go into the Bay of Bengal until 20 November, and heavy rain is forecast for Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and coastal Andhra Pradesh.
headlines.gk: Cyclones in the north Indian Ocean are named from a list prepared by 13 member countries of the WMO/ESCAP Panel. In the Northern Hemisphere, cyclones spin anticlockwise.

headlines.title: India beat Pakistan 2-1 to win a record 10th SAFF Championship title.
headlines.summary: India defeated arch-rivals Pakistan 2-1 in the SAFF Championship final at the National Stadium in Dhaka. Suhail Ahmad Bhat scored in the 60th minute and Sandip Mandi in the 88th minute. It is India's record 10th SAFF title and its third in a row. India had reached the final by beating Bhutan 2-1 in the semi-final.
headlines.gk: SAFF stands for the South Asian Football Federation; the first SAFF Championship was held in 1993. The governing body of football in India is the All India Football Federation (AIFF).

headlines.title: MS Dhoni ends his IPL playing career and becomes mentor of Chennai Super Kings.
headlines.summary: MS Dhoni's IPL playing career came to an end on 17 November after he was appointed mentor of Chennai Super Kings (CSK). Team co-owner Rupa Gurunath said Dhoni shared his wish to retire during a call to decide the players to be retained for next season. She said he will remain part of the CSK family as mentor. Dhoni had already retired from international cricket in 2020.
headlines.gk: Dhoni captained India to the T20 World Cup (2007), the ODI World Cup (2011) and the Champions Trophy (2013). The IPL (Indian Premier League) began in 2008.

headlines.title: India re-elected to the ITU Council for the 2027-2030 term.
headlines.summary: India was re-elected to the Council of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) for 2027-2030 at the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference in Doha, Qatar. The ITU Council has 48 members and acts as the governing body between the four-yearly Plenipotentiary Conferences. It oversees global telecom policies, strategic and financial plans, and working groups. Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia called the result a 'resounding victory'.
headlines.gk: The ITU is the UN specialised agency for information and communication technologies, founded in 1865 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
headlines.exam: Remember: ITU Council term 2027-2030; 48 members; Plenipotentiary Conference held in Doha, Qatar; ITU HQ Geneva.

headlines.title: India's electronics exports grow 44% to about USD 32 billion in April-September 2026-27.
headlines.summary: Electronic goods exports rose 44% in the first half of FY27, from over USD 22 billion to around USD 32 billion. Smartphone exports grew over 35%, from USD 13 billion to over USD 18 billion, but their share fell from 60.3% to 56.8%. Non-smartphone electronics grew over 56% to more than USD 13 billion, raising their share to 43.2%. Exports of mounted printed circuit board parts jumped from about USD 63 million to over USD 2 billion, with Singapore the top destination.
headlines.gk: The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme for large-scale electronics manufacturing was launched in 2020. The Ministry of Electronics and IT (MeitY) oversees the sector.
headlines.exam: Remember: +44% to ~USD 32 bn (Apr-Sep FY27); smartphones >USD 18 bn (56.8% share); non-smartphone share 43.2%.

headlines.place: Ministry of Commerce & Industry · New Delhi
headlines.title: WPI inflation rises to 12.29% in October 2026, led by fuel and power.
headlines.summary: Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation rose to 12.29% in October from 11.39% in September, as per provisional data. Fuel and power inflation shot up to 32.84%, while primary articles rose to 9.24%. Manufactured products eased slightly to 9.54% and the WPI food index dipped to 8.58%. Cumulative WPI inflation for April-October was 10.14%, against a contraction of 0.3% a year earlier.
headlines.gk: WPI is released by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce and Industry), with base year 2011-12. CPI (retail) inflation is released by MoSPI and is the measure the RBI targets.
headlines.exam: Remember: WPI Oct 2026 = 12.29% (Sep 11.39%); fuel & power 32.84%; food index 8.58%; Apr-Oct cumulative 10.14%.

headlines.title: India's unemployment rate falls to 4.9% in October 2026: PLFS bulletin.
headlines.summary: The overall unemployment rate fell by 0.3 percentage points to 4.9% in October, according to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) bulletin of MoSPI. Rural unemployment fell to 4.2% and urban unemployment to 6.7%. The Worker Population Ratio rose to 53%, with female WPR at 33.3% and male WPR at 73.7%. The Labour Force Participation Rate for people aged 15 and above rose to 55.7%.
headlines.gk: The PLFS is conducted by the National Statistics Office (NSO) under MoSPI. It measures unemployment by the Current Weekly Status (CWS) approach in its monthly bulletins.
headlines.exam: Remember: unemployment 4.9% (rural 4.2%, urban 6.7%); WPR 53%; LFPR 55.7% (Oct 2026, PLFS).

headlines.title: CSIR and the National Academy of Sciences of Belarus sign a cooperation programme for 2027-2029.
headlines.summary: The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) and the National Academy of Sciences of Belarus (NASB) signed their Second Programme of Cooperation for 2027-2029 in New Delhi on 16 November. It was signed by CSIR Director General Dr N. Kalaiselvi and NASB's Dr A. V. Trukhanov. The pact gives a fresh framework for joint research, R&D projects and exchanges between institutions. A Second Joint Call for research and innovation proposals will open from 27 November.
headlines.gk: CSIR was set up in 1942 and is headed by the Prime Minister as its President. Dr N. Kalaiselvi is the first woman Director General of CSIR. Belarus's capital is Minsk.
headlines.exam: Remember: Second Programme of Cooperation, 2027-2029; signed 16 Nov 2026 by Dr N. Kalaiselvi (CSIR DG); joint call from 27 Nov.

headlines.title: President Murmu says malaria cases and deaths have fallen by nearly 80% in 10 years.
headlines.summary: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the Golden Jubilee (50 years) celebrations of ICMR's National Institute of Malaria Research (NIMR) in New Delhi. She said malaria cases and deaths in India have fallen by nearly 80% in the last decade. High-burden districts came down from 155 to 33, and 160 districts reported zero malaria cases during 2022-2025. Health Minister J P Nadda said India is confident of eliminating malaria by 2030.
headlines.gk: Malaria is caused by the Plasmodium parasite and spread by female Anopheles mosquitoes. World Malaria Day is observed on 25 April. ICMR is India's apex body for biomedical research.
headlines.exam: Remember: ICMR-NIMR Golden Jubilee; ~80% fall in cases/deaths in 10 years; high-burden districts 155 → 33; target: elimination by 2030.

ai.title: Accenture and Google Cloud to bring AI learning to more than 1,000 schools and colleges in India.
ai.summary: Accenture LearnVantage and Google Cloud announced a partnership to bring AI learning to over 1,000 public and private schools and colleges in India. Plans include AI Labs powered by Google Gemini for young learners, Centres of Excellence, and courses in generative and agentic AI. Students will get personalised coaching and multilingual voice tools, and a certificate when they finish. The tie-up also supports Accenture's National AI Olympiad.
ai.gk: Generative AI creates new text, images or audio. 'Agentic' AI can plan and carry out tasks step by step on its own.

quiz.q: Which AI model will power the new AI Labs for young learners?
quiz.explain: The AI Labs will be powered by Google Gemini.

ai.title: Karnataka to teach AI and Python in 1,800 government high schools from Class 9.
ai.summary: The Karnataka government announced courses in AI, Python programming and data analytics for state schools. They start in Class 9 across 1,800 government high schools from the 2026-27 academic year. Modules cover AI basics, computer vision, natural language processing and generative AI. The courses are framed under the National Skills Qualifications Framework (NSQF), and guest teachers are being recruited.
ai.gk: Python is a popular programming language created by Guido van Rossum in 1991. NEP 2020 recommends coding from the middle stage of school.

quiz.q: From which class will Karnataka's government schools start the AI and Python courses?
quiz.explain: The courses start in Class 9 in 1,800 government high schools.

ai.title: IIT Madras-incubated Bodhan AI aims to train over 10 lakh teachers in AI.
ai.summary: Bodhan AI, an initiative incubated at IIT Madras, has partnered with Learning Links Foundation, Vidya Shakti and the Centre for Teacher Accreditation (CENTA) to train more than one million schoolteachers in AI over the next 12-18 months. It uses a three-phase train-the-trainer model. CENTA will lead the rollout in Andhra Pradesh. Vidya Shakti has already trained about 4,000 teachers in 6 states and 1 UT, who reported saving at least 30 minutes a day.
ai.gk: IIT Madras was established in 1959. NCERT, the National Council of Educational Research and Training, was set up in 1961.
ai.exam: Remember: Bodhan AI (IIT Madras incubated); target 1 million teachers in 12-18 months; partners Learning Links Foundation, Vidya Shakti, CENTA.

quiz.q: Bodhan AI, which plans to train one million teachers in AI, is incubated at which institute?
quiz.explain: Bodhan AI is incubated at IIT Madras.

ai.title: US moves to stop Chinese firms from using AI chips in data centres abroad.
ai.summary: The US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) announced a rule to stop Chinese AI developers from remotely using data centres in third countries, especially in Southeast Asia. Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil were named as having an 'unacceptable risk of diversion', so exporters need a licence to ship advanced chips there. China called the spying allegations groundless. Nvidia shares fell 4.1% on Monday.
ai.gk: BIS is part of the US Department of Commerce and controls exports of sensitive technology. Advanced AI chips (GPUs) are used to train large AI models.
ai.exam: Remember: rule by US Bureau of Industry and Security; five countries flagged — Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Brazil.

quiz.q: Which US agency announced the rule on remote access to AI chips?
quiz.explain: The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), under the Commerce Department, announced it.
